categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in environmental protection engineering (including water treatment, air pollution control, waste recycling, and incinerator construction), electromechanical equipment upgrading and maintenance, turnkey projects for laboratories and biopharmaceutical plants, cogeneration and power plant construction, solar photovoltaic system engineering, agency sales, and resource recycling plant operation. These segments collectively cover a broad range of engineering services from feasibility studies, design, procurement, construction, to operation and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced environmental technologies such as wastewater treatment chemicals, air pollution control including wet flue gas desulfurization and selective catalytic reduction for NOx removal, and carbon capture with a pilot plant capturing 500 tons of CO2 annually at 99% purity. It also integrates electromechanical system upgrades, solar power and energy storage systems, and develops bio-agents for ammonia nitrogen removal in wastewater. The production process involves comprehensive project management from market research, feasibility analysis, bidding, contracting, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, to after-sales service.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large industrial clients, especially the China Steel Group and its affiliates, which account for about 80% of sales. Other customers include public engineering projects and private sector clients, with a growing presence in Vietnam. The company serves industries requiring environmental compliance, energy efficiency, and infrastructure upgrades, including steel manufacturing, biopharmaceuticals, and water treatment sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in Taiwan, which accounts for over 98% of its sales revenue. It also has a smaller but strategic presence in Vietnam, focusing on local plant repairs, equipment upgrades, and sales of environmental and energy-saving products. The company’s headquarters and main factory are located in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream engineering service provider within the supply chain, offering integrated engineering, procurement, construction, and maintenance services. It acts as a system integrator and project manager, coordinating upstream equipment and material suppliers and downstream clients, thus bridging technical design and operational execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on engineering, operation and maintenance, circular economy, and sales business growth. R&D priorities include developing low-carbon and energy-saving technologies aligned with the 2050 net-zero carbon goals, such as carbon capture and utilization, advanced air pollution control, wastewater treatment bio-agents, and integration of renewable energy systems. The company also emphasizes digital transformation to enhance management efficiency and core technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through project-based engineering contracts, including turnkey construction, equipment upgrading, and long-term operation and maintenance services. Additional income streams come from sales of environmental products like LED lighting, activated carbon adsorbents, air purifiers, and chemical agents. The company also earns from consulting, feasibility studies, and after-sales technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading comprehensive engineering service provider in Taiwan’s environmental and electromechanical sectors, recognized among the top 10 engineering technology service firms in Taiwan’s large enterprises. It competes with domestic engineering firms by leveraging strong technical expertise, extensive project experience, and close ties with the China Steel Group. The company differentiates itself through integrated service capabilities and advanced environmental technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company achieved consolidated revenue of approximately NT$10.86 billion, marking an 11.27% increase from the prior year, with a net profit of about NT$501.9 million. Total assets stood at NT$7.16 billion with equity of NT$3.74 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial stability. The company maintains a stable profit base supported by long-term contracts, especially with the China Steel Group.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, one-stop engineering solutions combining environmental protection, electromechanical upgrades, and renewable energy integration, tailored to meet stringent environmental regulations and sustainability goals. Its competitive edge lies in advanced pollution control technologies, strong R&D collaboration with China Steel’s research units, and a proven track record of quality and reliability in large-scale industrial projects. The company emphasizes sustainable development, risk management, and customer-centric service to create long-term value.
